open_points.subject: runtime_settings
open_points.text: A default for a value nobody chose, or any check that uses a setting other than the start-up consistency of the two binary bounds (A14), which is a check of the table itself.
open_points.question: Which module owns and implements the start-up consistency check between BINARY_MAX_READ_BYTES and max_binary_response_bytes: runtime_settings as this passage says, or the emitted binary_storage backend whose A14 policy explicitly includes that check and is read only by binary_storage?
options: runtime_settings is the sole owner; remove the check from the binary_storage backend IR
binary_storage is the sole owner; remove this exception from runtime_settings
runtime_settings performs the check but binary_storage owns the policy, with an explicit dependency and division of responsibility
open_points.default_guess: Make runtime_settings the sole owner because configuration validation and start-up refusal otherwise have two implementing modules.
